data_quality.ownership_source: PROXY ONLY. xpts.json and squad.json have no selected_by_percent or form fields. league.json differentials and template arrays are empty, so the template comes from the league.json context string 'De Cuyper, Groß, Haaland, Tavernier, Raya' (18-manager mini-league, GW11). Web search found no 2026/27 GW12 elite or top-10k ownership or captaincy data (results were from 2024/25 and 2025/26 only). All eo_est values are heuristic: template membership + price + xPts. Confidence LOW.
data_quality.eo_definition: eo_est = own% + captain% (+ extra captain% for TC), as a percentage of managers in the mini-league / elite proxy
data_quality.xpts_note: Some xPts values look high for a single GW (e.g. Hill DEF 11.09, Muharemović DEF 10.18). They may cover a multi-GW horizon or a DGW. data-lab should confirm before sim-lab treats them as single-GW ceilings.

captain_shield.why: DO NOT FADE. He is the template captain and the season cum_pts premium, and APEX's locked captain rule picks the season cum_pts leader. His xPts this GW is only 4.48 (MCI fdr 5), which makes fading him tempting. But at about 150% EO, a Haaland haul with someone else captained costs about 1.5x his score in relative rank. The backtest showed fading template captains lost points. Captain him unless confirmed injury or lineup news says otherwise; the human override is still allowed. Groß (5.57 xPts, cap 11.14) is the only realistic in-squad alternative and is not a high enough ceiling to justify the risk.
